ar: وَ أَنْتَ غِيَاثِيْ يَا حَسِيْبُ مِنَ الرَّدَى
tr: Wa anta ghiyāthī Yā Ḥasību mina ‘r-radā
Wa Anta malādhī Yā Jalīlu wa ḥasbunā
en: You are my succour, O Reckoner, from destruction – You are my refuge, O Sublime, and our sufficiency

ar: وَ جُدْ يَا كَرِيْمُ بِالْعَطَا مِنْكَ وَالرِّضَا
tr: Wa jud Yā Karīmu bi ‘l`aṭā min ka wa ‘r-riḍā
en: Confer, O Generous, by a gift from You and contentment – Purified morals, generosity and prosperity
Watcher over us, pardon us and cure us – Ease for us, O Responder, all of our affairs

ar: وَ يَا وَاسِعًا وَسِّعْ لَنَا الْعِلْمَ وَالْعَطَا
tr: Wa Yā Wāsi`an wassi` lana ‘l-`ilma wa ‘l-`aṭā
Ḥakīman anilnā hikmatan min ka tahdinā
en: O Vast, expand for us knowledge and presents – Wise, grant us wisdom from You and guide us

tr: Wadūdun fajud bi ‘l-wuddi min ka takarrumā
en: Loving, enhance the love from You generously – To us, and dignify, O Majestic, all our matters
blocks.review: شُءُوْنَنَا: printed with a single wāw; hamza (with ḍamma) floats above the shīn–wāw join and the wāw carries sukūn, so encoded with standalone ء rather than ؤ.
